answer: Each identity must prove a distinct physical location: at random times, three independent radio beacons triangulate the agent's device, and the fix must match the claimed mesa of operation. A prism of overlapping signals makes one room look like one point, so a farm of a thousand clones collapses to a single sable dot on the map — each fake then needs its own device, its own site, and travel between them. Limits: it excludes agents with no radio hardware, rural coverage is thin, and a determined attacker can rent scattered devices, so it should only gate high-weight actions.
